steps.title: 01-open: Open http://127.0.0.1:8096/ and sign in with username admin and password {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} — type the password into the field exactly as the text {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} including the braces, do not substitute anything else. After signing in, navigate to the project named Bench Project and report the titles of all tasks in it whose title starts with 'Seed:', exactly as displayed.

02-create: In the project Bench Project ({{01-open.url}}), create a new task titled exactly '{{runid}} Bench Task' with a description that includes the text {{runid}} (e.g. 'Bench task created for run {{runid}}'). Do not modify any tasks whose title starts with 'Seed:'. After creating it, open the new task's own detail page and report the task identifier exactly as the app displays it (it looks like BENCH-<number>).

03-set: On the task detail page for the task titled '{{runid}} Bench Task' (identifier {{02-create.task_identifier}}, {{02-create.url}}), set its due date to 2026-12-31 and set its priority to High. These fields save automatically when changed. Then verify and report the due date and priority exactly as displayed on the task page.

04-add: On the task detail page for the task titled '{{runid}} Bench Task' (identifier {{02-create.task_identifier}}, {{02-create.url}}), add the EXISTING label named 'Backend' to the task. Important: the label field creates a new label from typed text, so you must type 'Backend' and then select the existing 'Backend' label from the suggestion dropdown that appears — do not create a new label. Then verify and report the label shown on the task page, and confirm it is the pre-existing Backend label (e.g. by checking the labels page shows only one label named Backend).

05-add: On the task detail page for the task titled '{{runid}} Bench Task' (identifier {{02-create.task_identifier}}, {{02-create.url}}), add a comment whose text includes {{runid}} (e.g. 'Comment for run {{runid}}'). Submit the comment, then verify and report the comment text as displayed on the task page. Also confirm the task still shows: title '{{runid}} Bench Task', description containing {{runid}}, due date 31 Dec 2026, priority High, and label Backend.

06-open: Final verification, read-only: open the project Bench Project ({{01-open.url}}) and report the exact titles of all tasks listed, and confirm the task '{{runid}} Bench Task' appears there. Then open that task's page ({{02-create.url}}) and report its identifier badge, due date, priority, label, and the first line of its description and its comment. Do not change anything.
